body:
forge-learn built and run twice, as asked. Full report:

WHAT IT IS: installed as .claude/skills/forge-learn/SKILL.md, authored directly from your own words in chat -- flagged explicitly as NOT a delivered charter document, unlike every other forge-family skill. It formalizes 4 techniques that already worked this session (structural pairing audits, cross-stage consistency audits, infrastructure tracing, real-time synthesis) rather than inventing a new mechanism. It explicitly refuses to claim "no bugs, no blindspots" as an achievable state -- that framing would be dishonest the moment it was installed. What it actually promises: every claim backed by a diff-verified fix or an honestly-reported clean audit.

PASS 1 (cross-stage consistency): found WARRANT#119 -- two different fallback threshold floors (50.0 vs 18.0) for the same "no validated edge" concept in Phase 3B, non-mutually-exclusive so the lower one silently overwrote the higher one whenever g_BaseThreshold landed in [18,50). Currently masked in every run watched this session (g_BaseThreshold has stayed near 70), but a real, mechanically-verified bug. Fixed.

PASS 2 (infrastructure tracing) found something bigger than TUNGSTEN itself: the SAME hardcoded-wrong-pwsh.exe-path bug from yesterday's events-feed fix also existed in relay-listener.ps1 -- the script that cold-starts a fresh Claude session whenever a mailbox message arrives with nobody watching. That's the entire mechanism async relay messaging depends on. Confirmed via .listener-error.log it fired repeatedly 2026-07-11 through 07-13, then went silent only because a session has stayed continuously active since -- masking it, not fixing it. Also found the SAME bug in install-relay-listener.ps1, whose own "fallback" path was already stale (version-pinned to 7.6.3.0 vs the actual 7.6.4.0 installed). All three scripts (events-refresh + listener + its installer) now resolve pwsh.exe dynamically via Get-Command. Wrote a persistent memory (pwsh_path_fragility_pattern.md) so this exact pattern is never rediscovered from scratch.

STATE: SLS(104)/10.18, 10 warrants total this session (#112-119 + 2 infra fixes). Sending source+ex4+ledger now.
